notable_quotes.best: simply amazing, a place that has come full circle after years of following it from afar.
notable_quotes.funniest: I think they relate to their customers more than almost any record store out there too.

vibe_description: Electric Avenue Music is described as having a 'really cool vibe' with knowledgeable staff and a welcoming atmosphere, making it a favorite among music enthusiasts. The shop's family connections and local expertise add to its charm.
staff_mentions: reviewers praise the friendly and knowledgeable staff, noting that they have a personal connection to the owners, who are described as pros in their field.
recommendation_for: music enthusiasts, especially those looking for independent record stores with local expertise and knowledgeable staff.
